claims.quote: Heterozygous de novo mutations in the GNAO1 gene cause neurodevelopmental disorder with involuntary movements.

claims.object_text: alpha subunit of Go, a member of the heterotrimeric Gi/o family of G proteins
claims.quote: Gα o, the gene product of GNAO1, is the alpha subunit of Go, a member of the heterotrimeric Gi/o family of G proteins.
We developed heterozygous knock-in Gnao1 +/R209H mutant mice using CRISPR/Cas9 methodology

claims.object_text: increased locomotor activity and a modest gait abnormality at 8-12 weeks
claims.quote: Mice carrying the R209H mutation exhibited increased locomotor activity and a modest gait abnormality at 8-12 weeks.

claims.object_text: did not show enhanced seizure susceptibility
claims.quote: the Gnao1 +/R209H mice did not show enhanced seizure susceptibility.

claims.object_text: protein expression levels unchanged in multiple brain regions
claims.quote: Levels of protein expression in multiple brain regions were unchanged from wild-type (WT) mice
the nucleotide exchange rate of mutant R209H Gα o was 6.2× faster than WT.
The atypical neuroleptic risperidone has shown efficacy in a patient with the R209H mutation.
It also alleviated the hyperlocomotion phenotype observed in our mouse model but suppressed locomotion in WT mice as well.
